historicalContracts.name: RollupProxy
historicalContracts.note: Pre-BoLD rollup core: confirmed state commitments (nodes) and managed the validator set; a compromised or maliciously upgraded RollupProxy confirms an invalid node, letting the Outbox release all escrowed Bridge funds (successor RollupProxy is critical today).

historicalContracts.name: ChallengeManager
historicalContracts.note: Pre-BoLD fraud proof adjudicator: resolved interactive challenges via the one-step provers; compromise or a malicious OSP upgrade makes invalid assertions win challenges and be confirmed, enabling theft of escrowed funds (successor EdgeChallengeManager is critical today).
